name: _a11y.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  _a11y.scss — accessibility utility rules for the DOCUMENT stylesheet AND
//  every component shadow root.
//
//  `.sr-only` — the visually-hidden pattern for helper-injected nodes (the
//  animation-description `<span>`s stamped by core/utils/a11y/animation-desc,
//  and draw-text's accessible real-text twin). The class token lives in
//  core/tokens/classes/a11y.ts (A11Y_CLASSES.SR_ONLY) and this rule is its
//  sole declaration site — the spellings match by construction, same
//  convention as the skeleton selectors.
//
//  Two delivery paths consume this one authored file:
//    1. Document: `@import 'structure/a11y'` inside _structure.scss — the
//       global <link> sheet, hiding light-DOM description nodes.
//    2. Shadow: `?inline`-imported into BASE_HOST_STYLES
//       (core/tokens/styles.ts) — BaseComponent prepends that text to every
//       component's adopted stylesheet (and to the legacy <style>-node
//       fallback), so shadow-injected description nodes are hidden too.
//
//  `display:none` is deliberately NOT used — the clipped-1px recipe keeps
//  the node in the rendered DOM for crawlers/AI readers and (when the node
//  is not aria-hidden, e.g. draw-text's accessible twin) for assistive
//  tech, while painting nothing on-screen. The anim-desc nodes carry
//  aria-hidden themselves: their text is crawler-only by contract.
//
//  `.sr-only-alpha` — opacity-based variant used ONLY for text twins that
//  must feed an ancestor's accessible name inside shadow DOM. Chromium's
//  `innerText` returns "" for shadow-tree content, so accessibility
//  engines that lean on it (IBM ace's <a> fast-path) fall back to a
//  content walk that treats `clip-path`-clipped nodes as hidden-from-AT
//  and never sees the twin. `opacity:0` stays invisible to users but is
//  counted by both Chromium's acc-name walk and IBM's isNodeVisible —
//  while `isNodeVisuallyHidden` (opacity<0.1) still exempts it from
//  contrast checks. position:absolute keeps it out of layout.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

.sr-only {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  padding: 0;
  margin: -1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip-path: inset(50%);
  white-space: nowrap;
  border: 0;
}

.sr-only-alpha {
  position: absolute;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
}

// `.skip-link` — the keyboard jump-to-main anchor, first focusable node
// inside the app-root shadow. Off-canvas until :focus-visible (pointer
// users never see it); on keyboard focus it slides onto the page with
// the themed surface/ink so the jump affordance is readable on any
// theme or dark-surface scene.
.skip-link {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  z-index: var(--z-top);
  padding: var(--space-sm) var(--space-md);
  background: var(--bg-primary);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  border: var(--space-hairline) solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(-110%);
  transition:
    transform 0.2s ease,
    opacity 0.2s ease;

  &:focus-visible {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}
